title: MeridianOS DomainPlugin record
description: DomainPlugin-as-data (card C2): a JSON/YAML record a tenant can author WITHOUT writing a code plugin. `domain-record.mjs`'s loadDomainRecord() compiles a record satisfying this schema into the same DomainPlugin shape config.mjs's resolveDomain() reads (see the code-plugin reference, tests/_fixture-domain.mjs). Data only — no functions can be expressed here; a custom guardrail is a set of declarative flags the loader compiles into a real check, not arbitrary code. Any field that would otherwise hold a secret (provider keys, MCP server auth) MUST hold an env-var NAME instead (BYO-key invariant) — this schema never has a place for a literal credential.

name.description: Tenant/product name. Informational — not read by resolveDomain today, but required so every record self-identifies.

roster.description: Agent ids. Compiles to DomainPlugin.agents (config.mjs resolveDomain).

modelRouting.description: Per-agent tier -> model id, plus an optional per-agent default harness. Keys SHOULD match `roster` entries. Compiles to DomainPlugin.defaultModels (tier map, `harness` stripped) and DomainPlugin.agentHarness (collected `harness` values) — see model-router.mjs's routeModel/launchAgent harness fallback.

harness.description: This agent's default harness (e.g. 'claude-code', 'antigravity', 'opencode'). Omitted -> harness-adapters.mjs's ultimate 'claude-code' default applies.

sources.description: Intake sources (ADR 0001 D2's IntakeSource contract, see inbox-source.mjs) this tenant reads from. Not read by config.mjs's resolveDomain yet — carried through loadDomainRecord()'s output as forward-compatible metadata for the D4 pluggable IntakeSource registry.

guardrails.description: Declarative flags for the content guardrail (README.md §6: tone/currency/secrets). The loader compiles these into a real in-process guardrailCheck function — a record can only pick from this fixed set of checks, never supply its own code.

currency.description: Flag hardcoded literal currency amounts (should be config-driven, not committed literals).

secrets.description: Flag secret-shaped literals (API keys, private key blocks, etc.) — belt-and-suspenders alongside the BYO-key invariant, which requires env-var NAMES everywhere else in this schema.

budget.description: Per-agent local usage store (budget.mjs's METER_READERS). Compiles to DomainPlugin.budgetMeter. Unset agent defaults to 'transcript' (see config.mjs).

boardTitle.description: H1 rendered atop the founder's board.md dashboard. Compiles to DomainPlugin.boardTitle.

riskTags.description: risk_tag -> sensitive-action name. Compiles to BOTH DomainPlugin.riskToAction (verbatim) and DomainPlugin.knownRiskTags (this object's keys) — the §6 governance hard-stop map and the risk_tag taxonomy validate.mjs's checkInvariants accepts.

taskCategories.description: Extra task categories MERGED OVER model-router.mjs's generic TASK_CATEGORIES defaults. Compiles to DomainPlugin.taskCategories ({tier,desc} only) and DomainPlugin.tagToCategory (collected from each category's `tags`).

tags.description: risk_tag/task_type values that route to this category — collected into DomainPlugin.tagToCategory.

mcpServers.description: Pass-through to DomainPlugin.mcpServers verbatim: either an array of {name,command,args?,env?}, or an object keyed by stage name to such an array ('*' is the any-stage fallback). Any `env` value MUST be an env-var NAME, never a literal secret (BYO-key invariant) — this schema has no way to express a literal credential. NOTE: yaml-lite.mjs cannot parse block sequences of mappings, so a record with this field must be authored as JSON (or the array flattened into a JSON value injected as an object), not YAML.

cliPath.description: The tenant runner CLI agents invoke for transition/update-task and the dashboard action map. Compiles to DomainPlugin.cliPath. Omitted -> config.mjs's own 'tools/aios/cli.mjs' default applies.
